evidence.sql:
WITH periods AS (SELECT 'baseline' period, ?::TIMESTAMP a, ?::TIMESTAMP b UNION ALL SELECT 'current', ?::TIMESTAMP, ?::TIMESTAMP)
      SELECT p.period, coalesce(sum(quantity::DECIMAL(18,0) * unit_price),0)::VARCHAR value, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN quantity > 0 AND NOT starts_with(upper(invoice_no),'C') THEN invoice_no END)::VARCHAR orders
      FROM periods p LEFT JOIN facts f ON invoice_time >= p.a AND invoice_time < p.b AND (unit_price > 0 AND NOT (starts_with(upper(invoice_no),'C') AND quantity >= 0)) GROUP BY p.period ORDER BY p.period

catalog.eligibility: unit_price > 0; exclude cancellation invoices with nonnegative quantity; preserve duplicate source lines
catalog.net_sales: Signed eligible quantity × unit_price; not cash collected
catalog.gross_sales: Eligible positive-quantity sales, excluding cancellation invoices
catalog.returns: Absolute amount of eligible negative-quantity lines, including cancellations
catalog.sales_orders: Distinct invoices with eligible positive sales
catalog.identified_customers: Distinct known customers with eligible positive sales; unknown customers still contribute revenue
catalog.avg_order_value: Gross sales / distinct sales orders; four-decimal half-away-from-zero rounding
catalog.caveat: Bookkeeping and return adjustments remain in source; contribution is descriptive, not causal

breakdown.sql:
SELECT country dimension, coalesce(sum(quantity::DECIMAL(18,0) * unit_price),0)::VARCHAR value, CASE WHEN invoice_time < ?::TIMESTAMP THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'current' END period
      FROM facts WHERE (unit_price > 0 AND NOT (starts_with(upper(invoice_no),'C') AND quantity >= 0)) AND ((invoice_time >= ?::TIMESTAMP AND invoice_time < ?::TIMESTAMP) OR (invoice_time >= ?::TIMESTAMP AND invoice_time < ?::TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY dimension, period ORDER BY dimension, period
